<Transition>.description:
Provides animated transition effects to a single element or component.
The wrapped content must be a single element; it is a renderless component, so it leaves no extra DOM node.

<TransitionGroup>.description: Provides transition effects for multiple elements or components in a list.

<KeepAlive>.description:
Caches dynamically toggled components wrapped inside, so their state survives being switched away.
Cached components get the `activated` / `deactivated` hooks instead of being destroyed.

<Transition>, mode + appear.description: `mode` is `out-in` (leave finishes before enter starts) or `in-out`; `appear` also runs the transition on the initial render.

<KeepAlive>, include/exclude/max.description:
`include` / `exclude` match against a component's `name` option and accept a string, a RegExp or an Array.
`max` (Vue 2.5+) caps the cache, evicting the least recently used instance.
